branded.why: A well-sold brand, but one supermarket brand among many, no part of a food culture of its own.

about.text: A soft, creamy Danish blue cheese from the Castello brand of Arla Foods. Pasteurised curds are dipped in salt water, pierced with small holes and ripened about 15 days at room temperature, then washed and packed.

sources.text: The words on what it is and how it is made, from these.
